name: Valiant Communications Limited
tagline: Micro-cap defense/critical-infrastructure communications equipment maker with exceptional returns (ROCE ~40%, ROE ~31%); the long-standing cash-conversion concern materially eased in FY26 (CFO Rs 32 Cr vs PAT Rs 24 Cr), leaving valuation (~57x P/E) and a low, declining promoter stake as the main watch-items
business_overview: Valiant Communications, founded 1994 in New Delhi, designs and manufactures niche telecom/critical-infrastructure equipment -- Digital Pair Gain Systems, PCM Multiplexers, Optical Line Terminating Equipment, teleprotection, GPS/NavIC primary reference clocks -- primarily for power utilities, with installations in 110+ countries. It has moved into OT cybersecurity / hardware isolation for SCADA and NavIC-enabled time-synchronization for data centres. Designated a 'Trusted Source' by India's National Security Council Secretariat and a Class-1 indigenous manufacturer.
fundamentals_table: Rs 85 Cr (+67% YoY); Q1 FY27 Rs 25.4 Cr (+39% YoY)
Rs 24 Cr (+152% YoY); Q1 FY27 Rs 7.8 Cr (PBT +81% YoY)
FY24 Rs 3 Cr, FY25 Rs 1 Cr, FY26 Rs 32 Cr -- cash conversion inflected in FY26
fundamentals_narrative: Core profitability is genuinely exceptional for the size -- ROCE ~40%, ROE ~31%, ~36% operating margin, near-debt-free, 5yr sales CAGR ~31% / profit CAGR ~166%. The working-capital concern that capped conviction last pass has materially eased: FY26 operating cash flow was Rs 32 Cr against PAT of Rs 24 Cr (vs Rs 1 Cr CFO in FY25), debtor days improved to 81 from 103, and the cash-conversion cycle fell to ~172 days from the ~400 figure flagged earlier. Growth is accelerating -- Q1 FY27 revenue +39% YoY, PBT +81%. The open items are now valuation (~57x trailing P/E, ~15.6x book) and a low, slowly declining promoter holding (39.65%, -0.97% in the last quarter), plus the inherent order-lumpiness of a Rs 85 Cr revenue base.

verdict_headline: Exceptional-return defense/critical-infra micro-cap where the cash-conversion doubt has now largely resolved; conviction rises to Medium, held back by a ~57x multiple and a low, declining promoter stake
verdict_reasoning: Returns (ROCE ~40%, ROE ~31%) and growth (5yr sales CAGR ~31%, Q1 FY27 rev +39% / PBT +81%) are both independently strong, and the trusted signal (Ghonarbochon) is genuine and repeated.

The FY26 cash-flow inflection (CFO Rs 32 Cr vs PAT Rs 24 Cr; debtor days 103 -> 81) removes the single biggest reason conviction was pinned at Low last pass -- cash generation now broadly matches reported profit.
The Power Grid / NavIC data-centre order and NSC 'Trusted Source' designation are specific, credible catalysts directly tied to the defense/critical-infrastructure positioning.

Offsetting: ~57x trailing P/E and ~15.6x book price in a lot; promoter holding is only 39.65% and drifting down; the Rs 85 Cr revenue base keeps order-lumpiness risk live. four_box score 3.0 keeps '10x-in-2-3-years' permitted; conviction set to Medium (no trusted floor active, valuation and promoter-stake caps prevent Medium-High).

four_box.note: tailwind yes -- power-utility comms modernisation, defense/critical-infra indigenisation, NavIC data-centre time-sync, OT cybersecurity: multi-year structural demand; tam weak -- Rs 85 Cr revenue base and niche addressable segments make a 10x off Rs 1,549 Cr a stretch, though the live Q1 FY27 inflection (+39% rev, +81% PBT) and data-centre entry argue for headroom; moat yes -- NSC 'Trusted Source' + Class-1 indigenous status, certified equipment for critical infra, high switching costs, 30+ yr track record, 110+ countries; valuation weak -- ~57x trailing P/E, ~15.6x book, catalyst substantially priced. Score 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted, conviction Medium.
